evals.name: github-open-post-note
evals.expected_output: Detect github. Confirm open. Post the default claim note. Best-effort add self as reviewer. Do not start a full review. Do not merge, approve, or change PR state. Report Claimed PR #12 on github with the URL.

evals.name: self-claimed-skip-second-note
evals.prompt: Claim MR !54 on GitLab. I think I already posted.
evals.expected_output: Open MR, but comments show you claimed a few minutes ago. Skip a second note. Tell the user it is already claimed. Do not spam.

evals.name: other-human-warn
evals.expected_output: Another human claimed recently. Warn and do not post unless the user said force. Do not steal the assignee.

evals.name: closed-do-not-claim
evals.expected_output: PR is merged/closed. Tell the user. Do not post a claim note unless they insist.

evals.name: unknown-host-ask
evals.expected_output: provider is unknown-pull. Ask once: GitHub, GitLab, or Gitea? Do not assume GitLab. Do not post until they answer.
